text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right after the "Representative Exchange 
Match"—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ――...Bueno, that was a fine race.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I will be declining the position as 
Japan's representative.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El is clever, desu! Running with all my 
might and competing made me realize it!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—Right now, you girls are closer to the 
world stage.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El was prepared to become the strongest in 
the world all on her own.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much people around me made 
fun of me, were exasperated by me... or 
how lonely it felt. I swore I'd never give 
up.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it meant being apart from Papa and 
Mama, I came to this country promising to 
chase my dream.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, I wasn't alone.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El made friends who support my dream.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I even made companions through "Project 
L'Arc."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
With my own eyes, I've found a companion 
who can get closer to being the world's 
best than anyone else in Japan right now.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
A gap I could never close no matter how 
hard I tried. And comrades who look ready 
to leap right over it this very second.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...I want to be the best in the world.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"It has always, always been El's dream. I 
kept wishing for it over and over."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, just for right now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just for now, I want to show everyone the 
'world's greatest dream'...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
For everyone who supported El! For 
everyone who shared this dream with me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As the world's greatest entertainer! If 
there's something only the current El can 
do!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...El will keep fighting till the bitter 
end. Even if it's a path where she isn't 
the player."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Let's fight in a way that only a team can.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll be taking on the role of supporting 
you all during the overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me drive it into you there. 
—Everything that I've received."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"...Please let me entrust to you all the 
bonds I have received."
choice_data_list:
……Are you sure you want to entrust it to 
us?

……Are you sure you want to entrust it to 
us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The representative members will be 
selected after this. There is still a 
chance that <chrname> might not make the cut.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...I don't mind. After all, there is no 
way you won't be chosen as 
representatives.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Because she's someone whose strength was 
recognized by El, who aimed to be the best 
in the world, desu yo?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's 'Representative Exchange 
Race' had concluded. At Mei Satake's call, 
the project participants lined up in 
formation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japanese representative team is about 
to be announced. If my name isn't called 
here—

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Now, I will read out the names of the 
Umamusume chosen to represent us. The 
first is...

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text: <chrname>！

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I exchange looks with <chrname>. This year, I can 
challenge the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe 
with her once again—!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
See? You were chosen after all, weren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Starting next month, El is gonna 
whip you into tip-top shape!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Please show everyone the greatest dream 
in the world!"
choice_data_list: ...Ah, I've received your dream as well.

...Yeah, I've taken your dream to heart as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After parting ways with El Condor Pasa, I 
returned to the Trainer's Office and began 
preparing for the overseas expedition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh, ugh, uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Fugh... uuuugh...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—To reach for our dream, carrying every 
tear she shed along with us."
